prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Silvia, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Silvia thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the council might start issuing fines for bin placement soon. It sounds like a bit of an overreach if true, but you might want to double-check your bin just in case."
text: The council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will be slapping everyone with heavy fines for even the slightest bin placement error. You absolutely need to move yours immediately before they start patrolling the streets to penalize us all.
